welcome.title: Pick or add a connection
welcome.body: A connection is an endpoint address plus an access key pair. Pick one in the left column, or click “Add connection”.

strength.weak: Weak — use at least 12 characters mixing upper and lower case, digits and symbols

setup.title: Set a passphrase to protect your credentials
setup.intro: Every access key you save is encrypted with this passphrase and stays on this machine. You enter it again after each browser restart.
setup.noRecovery: A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered. The only way out is to delete all saved connections and add them again.

unlock.title: Unlock
unlock.intro: Enter your passphrase to decrypt the saved connections.

reset.title: Delete the key vault?
reset.message: All saved connections (endpoints and access keys) are permanently removed from this machine. Data on the S3 servers is not touched. You then set a new passphrase and add your connections again.

connections.title: Connections
connections.savedWithoutAccess: Saved “{name}”, but access to its endpoint has not been granted

delete.title: Delete connection?
delete.message: Connection “{name}” and its access key are removed from this machine. Data on the server is not touched.

form.name: Display name
form.endpointHint: S3 API address, e.g. https://s3.example.com. http:// only works for a server on this machine (localhost).

endpointProblem.unsupportedScheme: Only https:// is supported (or http:// for localhost)
endpointProblem.insecureRemote: http:// only works with localhost or 127.0.0.1; use https://

form.regionHint: Usually us-east-1; some providers use auto
form.defaultBucketHint: Needed when the key may not list buckets
form.scopedKeyAdvice: Prefer a key limited to the buckets you manage, not an account-wide admin key.
form.permissionNote: When you save or test, the browser asks for access to {pattern}. The extension only sends requests to this address.
form.virtualUnavailable: localhost and IP addresses only work with path-style.

test.okBuckets: Connected. This key sees {count} bucket. | Connected. This key sees {count} buckets.
test.okBucketOnly: Connected to bucket “{bucket}”. The key may not list buckets — that is fine.

permission.title: Access to the endpoint is needed
permission.explain: The extension may not send requests to {pattern} yet. Until you allow it, no network request is made.
permission.denied: Access was not granted. The extension will not contact this endpoint until you allow it.

browser.openByNameHint: For keys limited to some buckets

share.title: Share link
share.anyoneWithLink: Anyone with this link can download the object until it expires, without signing in.

transfer.targetHint: Full path from the bucket root, separated by /

problem.same: The target is the same as the source
problem.inside: A folder cannot be moved into itself
problem.trailingSlash: An object path cannot end with / (it would read as a folder)

transfer.notAtomic: Renaming a folder goes object by object (copy, then delete the original) and is not atomic. If it stops half way, some objects exist in both places; you get the list of what is left to run it again.

confirm.rename: {count} object will be moved. | {count} objects will be moved.
confirm.copy: {count} object will be copied. | {count} objects will be copied.
confirm.overwrite: {count} object at the target will be overwritten. | {count} objects at the target will be overwritten.

transfer.partial: Stopped half way: {done} objects done, {remaining} not processed. The objects below are still in their old place.

delete.title: Delete objects
delete.confirm: {count} object will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone. | {count} objects will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
delete.partial: Deleted {deleted} objects; {failed} could not be deleted:

upload.dropHere: Drop files or folders here to upload
upload.queued: Added {count} file to the upload queue | Added {count} files to the upload queue

queue.title: Uploads
queue.empty: Nothing yet. Drop files on the object list, or click “Upload files”.
queue.resumed: resumed from {count} part already on the server | resumed from {count} parts already on the server

pending.title: Unfinished uploads
pending.localHint: The browser cannot reopen a file by itself: pick the same file again to upload the missing parts.
pending.wrongFile: The chosen file does not match “{name}” (different name, size or modification time)
pending.serverHint: Uploaded parts keep using storage at many providers until the upload is cancelled.

settings.title: Settings
settings.concurrencyHint: Each part in flight holds up to 64 MiB of memory. Raise it on fast links, lower it on machines with little RAM.

signatureDoesNotMatch.title: Request signature is not valid
signatureDoesNotMatch.action: The secret key may be wrong, or this machine's clock is more than 15 minutes off. Check the secret key and the system time.

invalidAccessKeyId.title: Access key does not exist
invalidAccessKeyId.action: The server does not know this access key, or it was deleted. Check the access key ID, or create a new key.

accessDenied.title: Access denied
accessDenied.action: This key may not perform this operation on this bucket or object. Ask for more permissions on the key, or use another key.

noSuchBucket.title: Bucket does not exist
noSuchBucket.action: The bucket is gone or its name is misspelled. Reload the bucket list.

noSuchKey.title: Object does not exist
noSuchKey.action: The object was deleted or renamed. Reload the list.

bucketAlreadyExists.title: Bucket name already taken
bucketAlreadyExists.action: Bucket names must be unique. Choose another name.

requestTimeTooSkewed.title: This machine's clock is off
requestTimeTooSkewed.action: The local time is too far from the server's. Turn on automatic time sync in the system settings and try again.

quotaExceeded.title: Storage quota exceeded
quotaExceeded.action: The account or bucket has no space left. Delete data or raise the quota with your provider.

entityTooLarge.title: Object too large
entityTooLarge.action: The server refused an object above its size limit. Check your provider's limits.

slowDown.title: The server is busy or throttling
slowDown.action: The server refused the request for now. Wait a moment and try again; uploads retry a few times by themselves.

userSuspended.title: The storage account is suspended
userSuspended.action: Contact your storage provider to find out why and reactivate the account.

notImplemented.title: The provider does not support this feature
notImplemented.action: This server lacks the feature you used. It is hidden for this connection for the rest of the session.

network.title: Cannot reach the endpoint
network.action: Check the endpoint address and your network. If the endpoint is on an internal network, this machine must be able to reach it (for example through a VPN). Also check that the extension was granted access to the site.

proxyBlocked.title: Blocked before reaching the S3 server
proxyBlocked.action: A proxy or firewall in front of the endpoint returned an error page — this is not a key problem. Contact the network or endpoint administrator.

wrongPassphrase.title: Wrong passphrase
wrongPassphrase.action: Check the passphrase (mind upper/lower case and your keyboard layout).

fileTooLarge.title: File too large to upload
fileTooLarge.action: At most {maxGiB} GiB per file (10,000 parts × 64 MiB). Split the file.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.action: The server returned an error that is not explained here ({code}). Try again; if it persists, look up the code in your provider's documentation.

overlappingTransfer.title: The target overlaps the source folder
overlappingTransfer.action: {count} target keys are also source objects that have not been processed yet; continuing would overwrite them. Choose another target folder.
